name: openwa
description: Open Source WhatsApp API Gateway - Free, Self-Hosted HTTP API for WhatsApp
author: Yudhi Armyndharis & OpenWA Contributors

scripts.dev: bash scripts/ensure-dev-ports.sh web && concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run start:dev" "npm run dashboard:dev"
scripts.dev:stable: concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run build && npm run start:prod" "npm run dashboard:dev"
scripts.smoke:engines: npm run test -- --testPathPatterns='session-engine|engine.factory|engine-auth' && npm run smoke:baileys
scripts.qa:engines: npm run smoke:engines && npm run test -- --testPathPatterns=session.service.spec --forceExit && cd dashboard && npm run test -- src/lib/session-health-utils.spec.ts && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/session-engine.spec.ts e2e/plugins-relink-banner.spec.ts e2e/link-safety-preflight.spec.ts
scripts.smoke:ai-learning: npm run smoke:ai && npm run test:ai-learning-api
scripts.qa:ai-learning: npm run build && npm run dashboard:build && npm run smoke:ai-learning && cd dashboard && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.qa:profiling: npm run build && npm run smoke:ai && cd dashboard && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/dashboard-profile-alerts.spec.ts e2e/followups-lost-demand.spec.ts e2e/ai-profiling-settings.spec.ts
scripts.qa:whatsapp-safety: npm run build && npm run test -- --testPathPatterns='whatsapp-safety|whatsapp-link-preflight|whatsapp-consent|whatsapp-cloud|product-demand-campaign|production-security|repair-renamed-migrations|dashboard-attention' && npm run test:e2e -- --testPathPatterns=whatsapp-safety-api && cd dashboard && npm run test -- src/lib/whatsapp-link-safety.util.spec.ts && npm run test && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/whatsapp-safety-panel.spec.ts e2e/campaigns-demand.spec.ts e2e/dashboard-demand-alert.spec.ts e2e/inbox-whatsapp-consent.spec.ts e2e/link-safety-preflight.spec.ts
scripts.qa:ai-cost-safety: npm run build && npm run test -- --testPathPatterns='ai-cost-safety|ai-model-router|ai-cost-tracker|ai-cost-permissions|ai-inbox-agent' --forceExit && cd dashboard && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/ai-usage-cost.spec.ts
scripts.migration:generate: npm run typeorm -- migration:generate src/database/migrations/$npm_config_name -d src/database/data-source.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:dashboard && npm run desktop:build
scripts.desktop:dev: bash scripts/ensure-dev-ports.sh desktop && npm run build:all && cd desktop && npm run dev
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build:desktop && cd desktop && npm run pack
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop && cd desktop && npm run dist
scripts.dist:windows: npm run prepare:desktop-pack && cd desktop && npm run dist:win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:desktop-pack && cd desktop && npm run dist:mac
scripts.prepare:desktop-pack: npm run build:backend && npm run build:dashboard && npm run prepare:desktop-runtime && node desktop/scripts/prepare-backend-deps.js && cd desktop && node scripts/generate-icons.js
scripts.desktop:repack: npm run build:all && npm run prepare:desktop-runtime && node desktop/scripts/prepare-backend-deps.js && cd desktop && node scripts/prepare-backend-bundle.js && npx electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.desktop:repack:sync: npm run desktop:repack && npm run desktop:sync && npm run verify:desktop-sync
